summary: The configuration the bound folder keeps for the application - its layout, and whatever else it chooses to keep - and the name it is kept under: the sha256 of its canonical JSON (keys sorted, no spaces, UTF-8). `config` is the application's own object; the server never reads into it. Null when nothing has been kept yet. `503 config_unreadable` when the folder names a configuration it cannot give back whole - missing, or changed since it was kept.
